research_goal: Evaluate a shared robotics simulation infrastructure for a review-only pilot across manipulation, navigation, and multi-robot coordination teams.
research_question: Which simulation infrastructure choices should be tested first to reduce onboarding time and improve experiment comparability, reproducibility, and provenance?
scope: Desk research and offline simulation planning only; no live robot or production simulator changes.
seed_hypotheses: Shared container images plus pinned ROS 2 distributions reduce onboarding time for new robot projects.
A central scenario schema improves cross-team comparability of simulator runs.
Versioned datasets, maps, and metrics improve the provenance and reproducibility of robotics simulation results.
